nice-c-te-d-azur-gorges-du-verdon-grand-.slogan: A 237 km loop out of Gorges du Verdon Grand Loop
nice-c-te-d-azur-gorges-du-verdon-grand-.story: A proper escape from Nice with roads worth waking up for. 237 km round from Lucéram - plan on about 4 h 18 of riding. The stops in between: Scenic stretch near Menton, Antibes and Saint-Laurent-du-Var. Cap-d'Ail is the high point. It tops out at about 1,500 m. It crosses France, Italy and Monaco - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Route des Grandes Alpes
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 37 km. 1172 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Col des Gets → Col des Aravis
scenicChapters.narrative: This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else. 47 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it.

scenicChapters.title: Route des Grandes Alpes
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 1967 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

route-des-grandes-alpes-thonon-les-bains.story: A 174 km one-way ride from near Thonon-les-Bains, about 2 h 49 of riding. It goes by way of Col des Gets, Col des Aravis and Col du Cormet de Roselend. The highest point is about 2,750 m. Cormet de Roselend is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
